t: An Infineon microcontroller with a built-in AI engine for voice, sound, and gestures.
steps: Buy the PSOC Edge E84 AI Kit from DigiKey or Avnet. It costs about 70 US dollars.
Connect it to your computer with a USB-C cable.
Install ModusToolbox, Infineon's free tool set, with Visual Studio Code.
Open the kit guide and pick the KIT_PSE84_AI board.
Build and flash a blinky example from the board package.
Try the MicroPython port next for quick sensor tests.
Explore DEEPCRAFT Studio to train your first sound model.
meta: Open Board. From $68.11. A few stores.
